case_summary: Threat actors gained initial access through a phishing campaign using malicious OneNote files, deployed IcedID and Cobalt Strike for persistence and lateral movement, then exfiltrated data before deploying Nokoyawa ransomware on critical servers.

tools_used.purpose: Monitoring system events for detection of malicious activities
Forensic analysis of disk images and memory dumps

source_title: From OneNote to RansomNote: An Ice Cold Intrusion - The DFIR Report
